cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me your practice slot before the audition. I'll tell the pianist to play my song instead.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've had your slot. This is my only run-through.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A run-through isn't the audition. You can still compete; I'm asking you to give me the preparation time. You said you were behind me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll lend you my practice recording. I need the pianist.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A recording isn't someone following you. Tell the pianist I'm taking your slot, then use the recording yourself.
